The '''Tolfrania system''' was a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the document known as the [[Tolfranian brief]], on which the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senatorial]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Eero Iridian]] was working on<ref name="LotJ">''[[Legacy of the Jedi]]''</ref> in [[89 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the section of ''[[Legacy of the Jedi]]'' in which the [[Tolfranian brief]] is mentioned to [[89 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tolfrania [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-9.<ref name="TEA" />
